writing_rules: Development-bank entries are sparse and created only for owners that need unresolved fractional development or a unit development cursor.
Credits store residual development units keyed by a stable capability target, never scheduled hours or free skill points.
resolved_through advances only after eligible activity through that time has been causally resolved.
A missing entry never grants progress; use the authoritative owner/process settlement cursor to begin lazy resolution.
Do not transfer credits between capability targets or owners.
